tasks.label: Build stock ROM
tasks.detail: Reassembles the untouched reconstructions (NIR 9o, NET 9n, CC710 9l, original CC784 9k and 9g). Each must stay byte-identical to its EPROM dump.
tasks.command: for f in cc784nir_9o cc784net_9n cc710_9l cc784_9k cc784_9g; do sjasmplus --fullpath --lst=$f.lst $f.asm || exit 1; done

tasks.label: Verify stock ROM is byte-identical
tasks.detail: Regression test for any edit to src/stock: NIR c021af146a50b93a22d13535201b7eaa, NET 872c87932339e9e072c5525d30ffb5df, CC710 f346d39e5aa7b49709a717c85d7c7e11, original CC784 9k 8429b5a4436faf434c18c27e822bd9aa and 9g 3e7a679f77d7dac121926182442f923a.
tasks.command: ok=1; for p in cc784nir_9o:c021af146a50b93a22d13535201b7eaa cc784net_9n:872c87932339e9e072c5525d30ffb5df cc710_9l:f346d39e5aa7b49709a717c85d7c7e11 cc784_9k:8429b5a4436faf434c18c27e822bd9aa cc784_9g:3e7a679f77d7dac121926182442f923a; do f=${p%%:*}; h=${p##*:}; if test "$(md5 -q $f.bin)" = $h; then echo "OK: $f.bin byte-identical to the dump"; else echo "FAIL: $f.bin no longer matches the dump"; ok=0; fi; done; test $ok = 1
